selected.capture_date: 2025-05-03 per the host taskbar clock visible in the image (9:32 PM, shown as 3/05/2025 in day/month order, consistent with the item date field)
selected.depicted_software_date: unknown from this file. Windows 3.1 was documented in Microsoft's April 1992 User's Guide (PC21669-0492). The build of the capturer's guest install is not shown.

selected.native_format: PNG, 1920x1080, RGBA (alpha fully opaque, 255), sRGB chunk, gamma 0.45455, pHYs ~96 dpi
selected.archive_checksum_match: SHA-1 and MD5 equal the values in the item's files metadata
version_model_evidence: Emulator window title inside the capture: 'Windows 3.1 [Running] - Oracle VirtualBox'.
VirtualBox Manager list inside the capture shows the selected VM 'Windows 3.1' as Running, separate from VMs named 'Windows 3.0' and 'Windows 3.11 for Workgroups'.
Limitation: these are user-assigned labels. No in-guest version string is visible. See evidence/claim-checks.json.
selected.depicted_content: Windows 3.1 guest screen at 640x480 inside VirtualBox. The Solitaire window has a green playfield, Queens on all four foundations, four Kings on the tableau, and the status bar 'Score: 383 Time: 311'. The guest uses a non-default colour scheme (black active title bar, red window frame) and a cyan patterned wallpaper.
